# API reference

This page is generated from the OpenAPI file, which is exported from the service code. When the API changes, this page changes with it.

All endpoints except `/health` need an API key. See [Authentication](authentication.md).

## POST /v1/generate

**Generate text**

Sends a prompt to a model and returns the response. The response includes an X-Data-Region header that echoes the region that processed the request.

Requires an API key.

### Request body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | string | Yes | ID of the model to use. List them with GET /v1/models. |
| `prompt` | string | Yes | The text you want the model to respond to. Length 1 to 4000 characters. |
| `language` | string | No | Language code of the prompt. Each model supports a different set. Default: `"en"`. |
| `max_tokens` | integer | No | Upper limit on tokens in the response. Cannot exceed the model's max_output_tokens. Default: `64`. Minimum 1. |
| `region` | string | No | Where the request is processed: ke, ug, ma or mu. Default: `"ke"`. |

Example request body:

```json
{
  "model": "lugha-demo-large",
  "prompt": "Habari, tafadhali nieleze Kampala ni nini.",
  "language": "sw",
  "max_tokens": 64,
  "region": "ug"
}
```

### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | The generated text and token usage. |
| 400 | The request was invalid. Check the message field. |
| 401 | The API key is missing or not valid. |
| 404 | The model or endpoint does not exist. |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. |

A `200` response has these fields.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Unique ID for this generation. |
| `model` | string | The model that handled the request. |
| `language` | string | The language code you sent. |
| `output` | string | The generated text. |
| `finish_reason` | string, one of `stop`, `length` | stop means the response ended naturally. length means it was cut off at max_tokens. |
| `usage` | Usage object | Token counts for this request. |

The `usage` object has these fields.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt_tokens` | integer | Tokens in the prompt. |
| `completion_tokens` | integer | Tokens in the response. |
| `total_tokens` | integer | prompt_tokens plus completion_tokens. |

Failures use the standard error body described in [Errors](errors.md).

## GET /v1/models

**List models**

Requires an API key.

### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | The models you can use. |
| 401 | The API key is missing or not valid. |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. |

A `200` response has these fields.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array of ModelInfo object | The available models. |

Each item in `data` has these fields.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Model ID. Pass this as model when you generate text. |
| `max_output_tokens` | integer | Largest max_tokens value this model accepts. |
| `languages` | array of string | Language codes this model accepts. |

Failures use the standard error body described in [Errors](errors.md).

## POST /v1/tokens/count

**Count tokens**

Requires an API key.

### Request body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | Yes | Text to count tokens for. Length 1 to 20000 characters. |

Example request body:

```json
{
  "text": "Habari ya asubuhi, rafiki yangu."
}
```

### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | The token count for the text. |
| 400 | The request was invalid. Check the message field. |
| 401 | The API key is missing or not valid. |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. |

A `200` response has these fields.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `token_count` | integer | Number of tokens in the text. |
| `word_count` | integer | Number of words in the text, split on whitespace. |
| `tokens_per_word` | number | token_count divided by word_count, rounded to two decimals. |

Failures use the standard error body described in [Errors](errors.md).

## GET /health

**Check service health**

No API key needed.

### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | The service is running. |

A `200` response has these fields.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | string | Always ok when the service is running. |
